entities.summary: Afag Masud is an Azerbaijani writer, and playwright. She has been honored with the title of People’s Writer, Honored Art Worker, a full member of Peter’s Academy of Art and Science, a full member of the European Academy of Sciences, Arts, and Literature, and a member of the Georgian Writers Association. Board Chair of the Azerbaijan Translation Centre and editor-in-chief of the “Khazar” World Literature Magazine. playwright, Honored Art Worker, "Humay" award winner, chief editor of "Khazar" world literature magazine, recipient of the Personal Presidential Pension of the Republic of Azerbaijan (2025).

historicalSignificance.significanceNarrative: Afag Masud's contributions to Azerbaijani literature and her recognition as a People’s Writer have had a significant impact on regional cultural development, with her work influencing a new generation of writers in the Caucasus region.
